summary:
Implemented an executable vertical slice of the Space Fractions fraction-learning game per the supplied architecture.

**Executable slice (Node.js + Express, per spec):**
- `lib/fractions.js` — fraction parsing/reduction/grading logic.
- `lib/game.js` — game state machine (Playing/Paused/GameOver), answer checking, score computation.
- `lib/questions.js` — question entity + in-memory repository (PostgreSQL-swappable interface).
- `lib/app.js` + `server.js` — REST endpoints for Play Game (FR-1), View Score, View Help, Update Questions (admin), state transitions, health.
- `test/` — 21 tests using `node:test`/`node:assert/strict` (no Jest). All pass.

**Architecture deliverables (as listed in the plan):**
- `openapi.yaml` (external API contract), `internal.proto` (internal RPC contract), `k8s/spacefractions-deployment.yaml`, `sql/game_ddl.sql`, `traceability_matrix.csv`.
- `IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md`, `ASSUMPTIONS.md`, `README.md` (setup/run + requirement-to-file mapping + limitations).

**Verification:** dependency install succeeded, `run_tests` passed 21/21, `validate_project` returned ok with no errors.

**Honest gaps documented:** persistence is in-memory (PostgreSQL DDL provided, no live wiring); OAuth2 (ASR-2) and the broader infra stack (Redis/RabbitMQ/Elasticsearch/Istio/Vault/Jenkins/Terraform) are architecture-level only; only FR-1/NFR-1/ASR-1 are explicitly enumerated in the source.
